You can use a Ring Video Doorbell Wired without a subscription, but your functionality will be limited to real-time use.
Without a subscription, you can view live video feeds,
answer notifications, and use two-way audio as events happen,
but you cannot save, review, or share video footage.Without a plan,
your Ring device functions essentially as a standard intercom with motion alerts:What Works: Live View streaming, two-way talk, and real-time motion/ring notifications.
What Doesn't Work: Video history, reviewing past events, snapshot captures, or advanced person/package detection.Storage: There is no local storage (such as a MicroSD card slot) to back up recordings.To unlock video recording and history, you'll need to purchase a Ring Home subscription (formerly Ring Protect).
